summary: Fusion Fuel Green PLC filed a Form 6-K on May 18, 2026, furnishing a Circular and Notice of Extraordinary General Meeting (EGM) scheduled for June 8, 2026. The EGM will consider three proposals; the board unanimously recommends voting in favor. This is a routine corporate governance filing for a shareholder meeting, not a special situation. The filing also announces a future investor update. No terms, prices, or structural changes are provided. There are no deal mechanics, advisor names, or risk-arb angles; the item is procedural, not event-driven.
